# EasyRPG Player

The optional independent RPG Maker 2000/2003 runtime is the official,
unmodified EasyRPG Player 0.8.1.1 Windows x64 release.

- Runtime: https://easyrpg.org/downloads/player/0.8.1.1/easyrpg-player-0.8.1.1-windows-x64.zip
- Archive SHA256: `49590bd595f60cd3a2833f9bea7dcb4b2f90b9a0d86ebf57423378fcdd50cd88`
- Corresponding source: https://easyrpg.org/downloads/player/0.8.1.1/easyrpg-player-0.8.1.1.tar.gz
- Project and build instructions: https://github.com/EasyRPG/Player/tree/0.8.1.1
- License: GPL-3.0-or-later; included source contains dependency and embedded font notices.

The product keeps the original RPG_RT executable in the new game copy and adds
PinhaoPlayer.exe and PinhaoStart.cmd. Encoding and both font arguments are tied
to the accepted native build. The runtime, corresponding source archive and
license travel with each exported legacy game. Special interpreter patches
remain a per-game runtime acceptance item.
